title: Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (CAMC) of Air Conditioning Plants at 'Deep Bhawan', of Goa Directorate - Reg.
summary: Short-duration GeM service bid for a one-year comprehensive annual maintenance contract covering 17 split air conditioners at the Deep Bhavan office of the Goa Directorate, Bambolim.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa

sites.name: Deep Bhavan, Near GMC Stadium, Bambolim, Goa 403202

scope.item: CAMC of Voltas inverter AC, 1.5 ton, purchased 2022
CAMC of Voltas inverter AC, 1.5 ton, purchased 2019
CAMC of IFB inverter AC, 1.5 ton, purchased 2019
CAMC of Lloyd non-inverter AC, 1.5 ton, purchased 2019

money.notes: Estimated bid value per GeM. GeM bid says EMD not required, but buyer ATC asks for EMD (BG/FDR/DD valid at least 3 months) or bid security declaration (Form 6) from MSME bidders. All spare parts and refrigerant gas included in quoted amount. Penalty 1% of contract value for the quarter if an AC is not rectified within three days of complaint. Bills with job sheets quarterly. MSE purchase preference applies.

eligibility: Minimum average annual turnover (3 years): Rs 5 lakh
3 years past experience of similar services to Central/State Govt/PSU (GeM); ATC asks minimum 2 years with Central/State Govt, local administration, Govt undertaking or private firm
Past similar services: three >= 40%, two >= 50% or one >= 80% of estimated cost
MSE and startup exemption from experience and turnover
Only local bidders within Goa suburb area considered; office of service provider in Goa (GST registration in Goa or incorporation/shop proof)
Proof of similar works in last seven years; non-blacklist affidavit (Form 5); tender acceptance letter (Form 3); undertaking (Form 4)
Dedicated/toll-free service telephone number and escalation matrix
specs: GeM category: Annual Maintenance service - Air Conditioner (IS 1391), high wall split AC, Voltas, 1.5 ton, inverter, vintage up to 5 years, comprehensive AMC, functional at time of bidding
Routine monthly check with dry cleaning; quarterly servicing with wet cleaning; complaint response within 24 hours (up to three days if spares unavailable)
